audit_name: Failure-Point Audit — Evidence -> Retrieval -> Writer Pipeline

executive_summary.conclusion: The Writer was not hallucinating; it was faithfully reflecting incomplete, missing, and incorrectly modeled upstream repository intelligence.

failure_matrix.claim: Frameworks: None detected by static analysis
failure_matrix.physical_truth: Uses React and React-DOM in package.json
failure_matrix.writer_output: Frameworks: None detected by static analysis
failure_matrix.root_cause: FrameworkDetector ignores package.json and Tree-sitter import extraction misparses TypeScript named imports
ENTRYPOINT_PATTERNS list omits .tsx and .jsx file patterns

failure_matrix.claim: README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md were referenced but their contents were not supplied
failure_matrix.writer_output: The primary project documentation files (README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md) were referenced but their contents were not supplied
failure_matrix.root_cause: discover_from_fact_store() hardcodes content = '' instead of loading file text

failure_matrix.physical_truth: 90 TypeScript UI component modules in src/components
failure_matrix.writer_output: Modules: None detected in table, components described in workflows

failure_matrix.claim: The codebase appears to be component-centric, with React-style .tsx files in src/components
failure_matrix.physical_truth: React TypeScript UI components in src/components
failure_matrix.root_cause: Correct inference from provided file paths

phase_comparison.phase2_recall: Phase 2 100% retrieval recall evaluated curated backend facts and does not establish complete JS/TS extraction coverage for Fact Store fallback paths
phase_comparison.phase3_baseline_integrity: Phase 3 safety baseline (3.5% hallucination rate, 0.0% leakage) remains fully valid. This audit confirms that Writer discrepancies stem from upstream extraction/retrieval omissions rather than generative hallucinations.

recommended_future_fixes.recommendation: Add package.json dependency parsing to FrameworkDetector for React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Vite, Tailwind.
Fix Tree-sitter import extractor to parse module string literals rather than text.split()[1].
Add .tsx and .jsx files (main.tsx, index.tsx, App.tsx, vite.config.ts) to ENTRYPOINT_PATTERNS.
Fetch documentation content from CodeFileFact or storage rather than setting content = ''.
